Session Log — cori.data.ipeds

Status as of 2026-06-29

Architecture overview (current)

The package has been fully refactored from a single-layer dictionary-driven pipeline into a clean three-layer architecture. Legacy processing files have been archived.

Three-layer ETL

NCES CSV (download)
      ↓
data_raw/           -- untouched NCES parquet; original uppercase col names;
                       original sentinel codes; only addition is `year` column
      ↓  reconcile_vintage()   (era-specific fixes: sentinel→NA, zero-pad, renames)
      ↓  apply_codebook_mapping()  (NCES uppercase → snake_case canonical names)
data_institution/   -- one parquet per survey×year; canonical names; geo attached
      ↓  process_ipeds_county()   (tidy 6-col aggregations)
data_county/        -- one parquet per year; 16 variables; tidy long format

S3 layout

s3://cori.data.ipeds/
  data_raw/survey={survey}/year={year}/part-0.parquet
  data_institution/survey={survey}/year={year}/part-0.parquet
  data_county/year={year}/part-0.parquet

Incremental by design: each layer skips vintages already written. Historic years are never reprocessed once written. Adding a new year = run write_ipeds_all(years = NEW_YEAR).

Key design decisions

Codebook as source of truth

inst/extdata/codebook.csv defines all 47 variables with: - variable — canonical snake_case name used throughout the package - nces_var — original NCES uppercase name in raw data (e.g. COUNTYCD) - survey — which survey the variable belongs to - level — "both" for variables shared across surveys (unitid, geoid) - era_notes — documents known schema breaks across vintages - alignment_notes — joins/crosswalks to other datasets

Critical: unitid and geoid have level = "both", which causes apply_codebook_mapping() to rename them in ALL surveys (not just IC). Without this, geo joins to completions and grad_rates would silently fail.

Era reconciliation layer

reconcile_vintage() sits between raw parquet and codebook renaming. Era fixes by survey:

IC: - 2024+: C00CARNEGIE → CARNEGIE (NCES renamed column) - All: sentinel codes (-1, -2, -3) → NA - All: UNITID zero-padded to 6 digits - All: COUNTYCD zero-padded to 5 digits (after sentinel removal) - All: geo columns added as NA if absent (guard for pre-2009 attempts)

Completions: - All: sentinel → NA, UNITID pad - All: race/demographic columns added as NA if absent (schema evolution) - Warns if pre-2009 doctoral AWLEVEL codes (9/10/11) appear

Grad rates: - All: sentinel → NA, UNITID pad, race columns padded

Grad rate GRTYPE structure (important)

GRTYPE (mapped to cohort_type) uniquely identifies the row’s role: - GRTYPE 1 = starting cohort (not used in county aggregation) - GRTYPE 2 = adjusted cohort denominator - GRTYPE 3 = completers within 150% of normal time numerator → grad_rate_150pct - GRTYPE 4 = transfer-out students numerator → transfer_out_rate - GRTYPE ≥ 6 = other sections (part-time, transfer-in, etc.) — excluded

County aggregation filters directly on GRTYPE values 2/3/4, not on CHRTSTAT.

County variables (16 total)

IC survey (7 counts): inst_count, public_inst_count, nonprofit_inst_count, fouryear_inst_count, twoyear_inst_count, hbcu_count, tribal_count

Completions survey (7): count_degrees_total (raw count, agg_var=NA), share_degrees_assoc/bach/masters/doctoral/men/women (proportions, agg_var=total)

Grad rates survey (2): grad_rate_150pct, transfer_out_rate (proportions, agg_var=NA)

All county aggregations restricted to degree-granting institutions (is_degree_granting == 1) with a valid geoid. Excluded sectors: 0, 99.

Tracked degree levels: AWLEVEL codes 2, 3 (associate’s), 5 (bachelor’s), 7 (master’s), 17, 18, 19 (doctoral). Excludes certificates and undocumented codes. All four level shares use this same universe → shares sum to exactly 1.

Validation (2023 data)

County rows: 21,092
Variables: 16 (all expected)

Share level sum: min=1, median=1, max=1  ✓
Sex share sum:   min=1, median=1, max=1  ✓
Grad rate range: [0, 1]                  ✓

Grafton County NH (33009) 2023:
  inst_count = 2 (Dartmouth + Plymouth State)
  count_degrees_total = 6,620
  share_degrees_bach = 0.665
  share_degrees_masters = 0.270
  share_degrees_doctoral = 0.065  ← Dartmouth doctoral present ✓
  share_degrees_assoc = 0          ← no community college ✓

Running the full pipeline

devtools::load_all()

# One year (new vintage)
write_ipeds_all(years = 2024, sync_to_s3 = TRUE)

# Full backfill 2010–2023 (skips already-written)
write_ipeds_all(years = 2010:2023, sync_to_s3 = TRUE)

# Layer-by-layer (useful for debugging)
write_ipeds_all(years = 2023, layers = "raw",         sync_to_s3 = FALSE)
write_ipeds_all(years = 2023, layers = "institution", sync_to_s3 = FALSE)
write_ipeds_all(years = 2023, layers = "county",      sync_to_s3 = FALSE)

Immediate next steps

  1. Run full backfill — write_ipeds_all(years = 2010:2024, sync_to_s3 = TRUE) (2024 IC and completions will write; GR2024 will be skipped — grad rates lag one year)

  2. Write vignette — vignettes/introduction.Rmd Suggested structure:

    • What IPEDS is and what this package provides
    • Reading county data, filtering by variable/year/geography
    • Using agg_var to recover raw counts from shares
    • Reading institution-level data
    • Annual update workflow for maintainers

  3. Clean up archive/ — if files in archive/ remain unused after the backfill is confirmed, delete them permanently.

  4. CIP-to-SOC crosswalk — completions data is stored at the institution × CIP × award level grain in data_institution but CIP detail is discarded during county rollup. A CIP-to-SOC crosswalk would enable county-level variables like “share of degrees in STEM fields” or alignment between local degree production and employer demand. NCES publishes a CIP-to-SOC crosswalk; BLS O*NET is an alternative source. This would add new variables to data_county and new rows to codebook.csv.

Known issues / things to watch

  • GR2024 returns 404: Grad rates lag by an extra year. 2023 is the latest available. This is expected NCES behavior.

  • ed_level 21 appears in raw completions data. Not a documented NCES AWLEVEL code. Safely excluded by TRACKED_DEGREE_LEVELS filter.

  • Pre-2009 extension — planned future work. geoid (NCES COUNTYCD) was added to IC in 2009; would need ZIP-to-county crosswalk for earlier years.
